### Day Forty-One
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/whispers-of-hope-10-weeks-of-devotional-praye/whispers-of-hope-10-weeks-of-devotional-prayer-woh04-content-40.html
Passage: 2 Kings 10:31
Points:
- Jehu successfully abolished Baal worship, yet his spiritual record was marred because he tolerated Jeroboam's golden calves.
- He excelled in high-intensity, dramatic battles, but lacked the discipline needed for daily, faithful walking with the Lord.
- Believers can fall into the trap of seeking emotional adrenaline or revival highs rather than the Most High God.
- Genuine devotion is found in cultivating a humble, quiet relationship with God through everyday life.

### Bible Pathways 05/04/2002
Author: Bible Pathways
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-05-or-04-or-2002-1133410.html
Passage: 2 Kings 10:31
Points:
- God utilized Jehu as an instrument of judgment against Ahab's dynasty and to wipe out Baal worship.
- Despite sweeping outward reforms, Jehu stopped short of true obedience by preserving the calf idols at Bethel.
- Jehu's boastful zeal masked a self-interested agenda rather than complete surrender to God.
- A person can perform useful work for God externally while remaining inwardly insincere and divided in heart.
